description: This file implements network interface and address management functionalities, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as classes for iterating over network interfaces, managing IP addresses, and handling routing information within the WPEFramework Core namespace.
external_files: <windows specific headers like iphlpapi.h, winsock2.h, ws2ipdef.h on Windows>
<POSIX headers like arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, net/if_arp.h, rtnetlink.h, net/if.h, netinet/in.h, sys/ioctl.h, sys/socket.h on POSIX systems>
<Apple specific header like net/if_dl.h on macOS>

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, with methods for address manipulation and host address retrieval.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Encapsulates a network node identifier, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 address representations.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to bring interfaces up/down, add/delete IP addresses, and manage gateways.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Manages routing entries, including adding, removing, and querying routes, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters/interfaces, providing access to properties like name, MAC address, and status.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network adapter events and status changes, allowing registration and notification callbacks.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing network interfaces and addresses, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, including netlink socket communication.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information on Windows using GetAdaptersAddresses.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the number of network adapters.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string.

methods.name: Network::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network.

methods.name: Network::Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink messages.
